resources.string: Se anlicnesse hiwawendere ne mihte onginnan. Seo anlicnes ne wæs inlæded.
Seo frume SVG-micelnes oferstigþ Android-pricanlicnessa gemetu. Nan micelnesse awending ne wæs gedon.
Þis gewrit oferstigþ þæt 512 MiB gemet to inlædinge. Ceos læsse gewrit.
Weorctoles gereord\n\nAwendinga sind gehealdene on AN Paint-gereordgewritum. Niwe oþþe unawend gewrit biþ on Engliscum gereorde ætywed.
Seo anlicnes and þa hwilendlican hord to tacngewritunge oferstigaþ þæt gemyndgemet to utberunge.

Betere godnes wyrcþ gewunelice mare gewrit. Butan lyre gehealden biþ ælc hiwgetæl.
Þeah utweorc hæbbe þa læstan micelnesse, ne mæg man þas anlicnesse inlædan to awendinge innan þam andweardan gemyndgemetum. Ablin and bruc læssan frumanlicnesse.

%1$s Sylfhealdung is hwilendlice oþstilled þæt þæt weorcgewrit gehealden beo. Bruc «Gewrit → Utberan efenwyrhte to eftstaþelunge…» þæt þu hit healde, and «Gewrit → Healdan swa…» (Gewrites hiw: PNG / JPEG) þæt þu þin andwearde weorc healde.
Ne mihte man utberan þa efenwyrhte to eftstaþelunge
Wyrc efenwyrhte dæles oþþe bruc «Metan → Insettan → Oþre anlicnessa».
Heald efenwyrhte on þinre gecorenan stowe; ceos þonne weorctol þæt hit hie dæle. Þin andwearde «Healdan»-stow wunaþ unawend.
Man hylt nu þæt weorcgewrit. Costna eft æfter lytlum fæce.
Ne mihte man þæt ærre weorcgewrit sundor healdan.
Ne mihte man þæt ærre weorcgewrit eft staþelian.
Þæt ærre weorcgewrit þearf maran gemynde þæt man hit eft openige.
Þis %1$s hæfþ %2$s anlicnessa on endebyrdnesse. AN Paint awent stille anlicnessa and ne hylt þa styrunge.
Seo forme anlicnes þære styrunge an biþ inlæded. Healdung wyrcþ stille anlicnesse.
Þis PNG hæfþ sundor foregesette anlicnesse. Seo anlicnes biþ inlæded on þara anlicnessa þære styrunge stede. Healdung wyrcþ stille anlicnesse.
Þis %1$s is swa earfoðe to oncnawenne þæt man ne mæg gewisslice witan hwæþer hit hæfþ ma þonne ane anlicnesse on endebyrdnesse. AN Paint openaþ stille anlicnesse ane and ne hylt nane styrunge.
Seo geendode anlicnes ne mihte cuman on þæs gewrites stede þe heo sceolde awrixlan.
Hylt anlicnesprican ufan on þære wynstran healfe. Læssan metingbordgemetu forlætaþ prican begeondan þam swiþran oþþe neoþeran ende; «Undon» staþelaþ hie eft.
Ne is genog gemynd to þissum weorce æt þære fruman bræde and heahþe on anlicnespricum. Nan sylfwyrcende micelnesse awending ne wæs gedon.
Ne mihte man þæt ærre weorcgewrit lædan to efenwyrhte to eftstaþelunge.
Ne mæg man wyrcan þæt hord to undonne. Gerym sume hordstowe on þam searwe and costna eft.
Þæt hord to undonne is gebrocen.
Þæt metingbord wæs eft gestaþelod, ac ne mihte man rædan his awendinga endebyrdnesse to undonne. Þæt frume weorcgewrit is gehealden swa efenwyrht to eftstaþelunge.

%1$s Sundor efenwyrht to eftstaþelunge is gehealden. Bruc «Gewrit > Utberan efenwyrhte to eftstaþelunge» þæt þu hire ZIP healde. Nim canvas.png ut of þam ZIP and inlæd þa anlicnesse þæt þu þara gewunelicra cyra to awendinge þære micelnesse bruce, gif þearf biþ.
Efenwyrht to eftstaþelunge is utboren. Nim canvas.png ut of þam ZIP and opena hit mid «Gewrit > Inlædan anlicnesse». Þæt ZIP hæfþ eac þæs weorcgewrites gesetnessa and ænigne unfæstne gecorenne dæl.
Utber anlicnesse on ICO-hiwe, Base64-gewrit oþþe ASCII-metunge. Utberung læt þa andweardan anlicnesse and hire «Healdan»-stowe unawende.
Writeþ anfeald gewrit mid leohtum and deorcum stafum. Sceawa hit swa þæt ælc stæf hæbbe rum þære ilcan bræde. Þis is gesewenlic onlicung; man ne mæg hit eft openian swa þa fruman anlicnesse.
Þeos anlicnes bricþ anre hiwgesetnesse þe AN Paint ne mæg giet awendan. Awend hie to sRGB PNG on weorctole þe þa anlicnesse awent be hiwgesetnessum ær þu hie inlæde.

Stille anlicnes, oþ 256 hiwa. Anlicnesprican mid mislicum hiwum, be endebyrdnesse gesette, gesmeþiaþ hiwa awendinga þe stæpmælum cumaþ. Styriende GIF-gewrit biþ opened swa seo forme anlicnes his styrunge.
Writ gewrites naman butan þam tacnum «/» and «\\» oþþe steortacnum.
Ne mihte man þa gewritu be þære anlicnesse wyrhtum, fruman and leafnessum healdan oþþe eft staþelian. Man hylt giet þa gewritu þe man ær heold. Costna eft.
Þas gewritu be þære anlicnesse wyrhtum, fruman and leafnessum woldon don þa metinge to micle to eftstaþelunge. Man hylt giet þine ærran metinge and hire gewritu.
Sume gewritu be anlicnessa wyrhtum, frumum and leafnessum, þe man ær heold, ne mihte man rædan. Heora efenwyrhta sind giet on horde.

%1$d × %2$d anlicnesprican (%3$.2f MP) sind ofer þæt andwearde orsorge awendinggemet, %4$.2f MP. AN Paint hylt ealle þa anlicnesse on gemynde and healdeþ stowe to hiwawendingum and gecorenum dælum. Þæt gemet biþ gesett be þære gemynde þe to brucenne is. Þæt weorc wæs gestilled ær man stowe on gemynde sealde þære to miclan pricanlicnesse. Nan sylfwyrcende micelnesse awending ne wæs gedon.

Hit is bemeten þæt þeos samnung oferga þæt andwearde weorcgemyndgemet, þeah þe man þa læstan gemetu þæs utweorces ceose. Þære samnunge gemetu læssian butan oþrum awendingum ne is genog under þam andweardan gemetum. Beluc oþru gewritu oþþe gearwa læssan frumanlicnesse ær þu eft costnige. Þin samnung is unawend.
%1$s utboren. Þin meting eall hæfþ awendinga þe man giet ne heold; heald efenwyrhte ealre þære anlicnesse ær þu þa metinge awrixle.
On þam horde to undonne is ma þonne man wende.

Man bemet þa gemyndbrucunge be þam andweardan metingborde, þære efenwyrhte þe man hylt to insettenne, tacnrædinge þe mæg anlicnespricena getæl læssian, and hwilendlicum hordum to awendinge. Seo soþe gemyndbrucung is mislic. Læsse efenwyrht forlyst smæle dælas. Þæt frumgewrit wunaþ unawend.
Man awent PDF-trametas to anlicnessum æt 144 dpi. Stafas and hiw þe man gemearcaþ be eorðcræfte mid stricum and bogetungum weorþaþ anlicnesprican.
Android ne mihte gewritceosere findan. On Android-gesetnessum do þæt weorctol «Files» oþþe «Documents» gearu to brucenne, þæt hit weorcan mæge; costna þonne eft.
Se tacnrædere and þa hwilendlican hord to awendinge þurfon nealice %1$s; þæt andwearde orsorge awendinggemet is %2$s. Ceos læssan efenwyrhte.

Seo fulle anlicnes and þa hwilendlican weorchord oferstigaþ þæt andwearde orsorge gemet, oþþe Android ne mihte him stowe on gemynde syllan. Awend micelnesse anre efenwyrhte þæt þu hie awendan mæge. Þin frumgewrit wunaþ unawend.
Þis gewrit ne is anlicnes þe þis weorctol inlædan mæg. Bruc PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP, GIF, DIB, TIFF, ICO, PDF oþþe anlicnesse on Base64-stafum.
Writ gemetu maran þonne 0, swa þæt ælc gemet, on anlicnespricum geteald, hæbbe huru 1 anlicnesprican.
Bruc niwes gemetes þæt sie mare þonne 0.
Sniðunggemetu sceolon wunan innan ælcre anlicnesse; bruc halra anlicnespricena oþþe hunddæla.
Sniðunge foresceawung. Teoh rand oþþe hyrnan; teoh innan þære sniðunge þæt þu hie astyrie.
On þissum gewrites hiwe sceal man ærest þa frumanlicnesse oþþe hire styccu tacnrædan, ær man micelnesse awende. Þeah utweorc sie læsse, mæg hit giet maran gemynde þurfan þonne gearu sie.
Þæt SVG ne cyþ nan gemet þære fruman micelnesse þe man brucan mæge. Man ne sette nan gemet be metingborde on his stowe.
Þeos anlicnes brycþ anre ICC-hiwbisene þe se anlicnesse tacnrædere ne mæg awendan. Ber ærest RGB-efenwyrhte ut on weorctole þe þa anlicnesse awent be hiwgesetnessum.
Nis her nan anlicnesse andweorc þe man rædan mæge.
Se gecorena syllend ne sealde nan anlicnesse andweorc.
Writ metingbordes gemetu maran þonne 0, innan þam gemetum þe Android for stowgetalu hæfþ.
Ceos læssan efenwyrhte þæs utweorces. Þa frumanlicnessa and þa sniðunge gesetnessa wuniaþ æt heora fruman bræde and heahþe on anlicnespricum.
Ne mihte man þa sniðunge don.
Hiwbord. Hrin þæt þu forgrundes hiw ceose; hrin leng þæt þu bæcgrundes hiw ceose. Scriþ þæt þu ma hiwa geseo.
